notes: §1985:XIII.3.11.3 SR2: "Within a given print line, the printable items must be defined in ascending column number order such that each printable item defined occupies a unique sequence of contiguous character positions." ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportColumnArrangement walks each line's NominalPlacements (printable-size from the picture, sign and editing included) and refuses, with COBOL2745, absolute columns not in increasing order (§2023:13.18.14.3 SR7) and overlapping items (SR8 a)) at every edition; PRESENT WHEN, PLUS and RIGHT/CENTER COLUMN are refused at 85 (COBOL0900). But both refusals are excused for two items 'each subject to a different PRESENT WHEN clause', and PresentWhenClausesOf counts a GROUP INDICATE clause as one (§2023:13.18.28.4 GR1) with no edition arm, so at 85, where SR2 has no exception, two GROUP INDICATE items written out of order or overlapping compile. Probes at 85 (work-slice-54/c5*; classes b, c, d): adjacent COLUMN 1 X(3)/COLUMN 4 runs; overlap, the same column twice, a SIGN LEADING SEPARATE S9(3) at 1 with an item at 4, edited ZZ9.99- and ZZZ9 BLANK WHEN ZERO items overlapping the next, and one GROUP INDICATE item overlapping a plain one each print COBOL2745; COLUMN PLUS 2, COLUMN RIGHT 9 and PRESENT WHEN print COBOL0900; COLUMN 10 then COLUMN 1, and COLUMN 1 X(5) then COLUMN 3 X(3), both with GROUP INDICATE, compile and run ('RAN'). The witness (COLUMN 10 then COLUMN 1, no clause) is refused with COBOL2745. kb/Work PB5251 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-54.json).

next.reason: 1985 requires printable items in a line in ascending column order, each occupying unique positions, with no exception. 2023 allows absolute items 'not in increasing numerical order' and overlapping items when each is 'subject to a different PRESENT WHEN clause' (§2023:13.18.14.3 SR7, SR8a); a multiple COLUMN clause keeps increasing order (§2023:13.18.14.3 SR10b); an overlap at print time sets EC-REPORT-COLUMN-OVERLAP with undefined results (§2023:13.18.14.4 GR4). A 1985 program (no PRESENT WHEN) is refused the same way; 2023 accepts sources 1985 refused. Looser.
